description: Repairs r-def-expr-sql/ddl-name-and-size-limits: every INSERT was refused, so no accepted width was found. Asks which record width an INSERT accepts: tables of n = 1 to 8 Text(255) columns, one row each whose every column holds 255 'x' (Wx<n>) and, separately, 255 euro signs (We<n>), each INSERT with dbFailOnError and Errors, then the row count and first column length read back. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
